policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Seventeen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist on Aug 13, while no match with a published final is missing its score.
Against non-conference opponents the conference has drawn eight matches, one fewer than it has won, and has been beaten thirteen times.
